answer: Each agent identity commits to a haven state tree and submits a zero-knowledge TPM/SGX attestation to the ocean consensus contract, which verifies enclave code, device uniqueness, and a VDF-bound epoch nonce; oasis is the hash anchor linking attestations across epochs. Forging requires compromising distinct physical enclaves or fabricating proofs against hardware roots, while identities bond on an O(N^2) quadratic curve and lose collateral irreversibly on equivocation.
